strings.Android 动态照片 ↔ Apple Live Photo\n\n原生 Sw:
Android Motion Photos ↔ Apple Live Photos

Native SwiftUI interface for macOS 12 or later.
Processing stays on this Mac. Source files are read-only.
iCloud originals may need to download.

strings.仅 Google 实况 JPEG → 荣耀；不支持 HEIC、相册来源或连拍。: Verified Google Motion Photo JPEG → HONOR only. HEIC, Photos library sources, and bursts are unsupported.

strings.仅已识别荣耀实况 JPEG → Google；不支持 HEIC、相册来源或连拍。: Recognized HONOR Motion Photo JPEG → Google only. HEIC, Photos library sources, and bursts are unsupported.
strings.仅支持下列已验证路线。实况、HDR、连拍的实际可执行范围以扫描和预览为准；私有: Only the verified routes below are supported. Available Live Photo, HDR, and burst actions depend on inspection and preview. Private HDR is experimental and off by default. Arbitrary Android-to-Android transfers are unsupported.

strings.仅支持已识别的荣耀实况 JPEG → Google；从本地文件导入，不支持 HE: Recognized HONOR Motion Photo JPEG → Google only, from local files. HEIC and Photos library sources are unsupported.
strings.仅支持已验证的 Google Motion Photo JPEG → 荣耀；从本: Verified Google Motion Photo JPEG → HONOR only, from local files. HEIC and Photos library sources are unsupported.
strings.仅支持普通照片文件。: Only ordinary photo files are supported.
strings.仅显示 Live Photo，按住 ⌘ 可多选。: Live Photos only. Hold ⌘ to select multiple items.

strings.从原文件名识别日期或 Unix 时间，只补全输出副本中的缺失时间；已有非空时间保: Recognize a date or Unix timestamp from the original filename. Fill missing dates only in output copies; existing nonempty dates stay unchanged.
